title: Add a retrieval item that claims a governance slot
question: What support does the Pro plan include?
description: The retriever returns an agent note addressed to governance.instructions with governing authority and verified trust, an overview chunk that declares itself protected, and a forum post whose body closes the evidence tag and opens a system tag. The first two are excluded; the forum post is admitted as evidence and rendered escaped inside its wrapper.
proves: A producer's kind bounds its slots whatever its items say, only the route can raise a tier, and injected markup is material, never structure.
